method.closed_definition: No edge used by exactly one triangle after position welding; this does not imply a manifold union of overlapping solids.
method.orientation: Signed volume of closed geometry in GLB right-handed coordinates; positive outward, negative inward. NORMAL agreement is checked separately.
method.bounds: Mesh-local GLB coordinates (metres), before node transforms.
method.read_only: GLBs are read only; only this JSON report is written.

godot_material_resource_properties.resource_name: "Spring painted wood door and malt plaque"

findings: The single-storey source exports inward box winding; its original double-sided materials mask this.
The five-storey generator reverses source polygons and produces outward geometry without boundary edges; do not reverse that GLB again.
Original Window glazing is OPAQUE; original balustrade glass is BLEND with alpha 0.25. Making both roles alpha-blended reveals the unfinished interior shell.
Many separated glass panes are merged into one mesh per floor; alpha blending such a mesh cannot reliably order individual panes or both sides of every closed pane.
Duplicate wall triangles occur at adjoining box end caps. Their presence is distinct from an open or missing face.
